advice.executiveSummary: Critical P0 issues identified: (1) Template generation produces garbled output with placeholder text 'уточняется' instead of actual values - affects UV001, UV004, UV006, UV016, UV017; (2) Multi-turn context loss in UV017 where Turn 2 fails to deliver shortlist and response is truncated; (3) Anti-link-gate logic still fails in UV012/UV022 when company context exists but not explicitly passed to lookup functions. Pass rate is 90.9% (20/22) with 2 strict failures. Judge evaluation shows 0% usefulness for UV017 due to hallucinated placeholder spam. Root cause: template post-processing logic in repairTemplatePlaceholderSpam() and sanitizeUnfilledPlaceholdersInNonTemplateReply() is insufficient - it replaces placeholders with 'уточняется' but fails to then substitute with actual extracted values from conversation history.

priorityPlan.title: Fix template placeholder spam (уточняется cascade)
priorityPlan.why: UV017, UV001, UV004, UV006, UV016 all show garbled template output with repeated 'уточняется' instead of actual values. This makes templates completely unusable. Judge scored usefulness=1.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Eliminates 100% of placeholder garbage in templates. Improves usefulness score from 1 to 4-5 for template scenarios.

priorityPlan.title: Fix multi-turn shortlist truncation in UV017
priorityPlan.why: Turn 2 response in UV017 is truncated and includes user's query text instead of proper shortlist. Indicates context loss between turns.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: UV017 strict pass rate improves from FAIL to PASS. Enables proper shortlist delivery in multi-turn vegetable sourcing queries.

priorityPlan.title: Strengthen anti-link-gate for UV012/UV022
priorityPlan.why: UV012.T2.C2 and UV022.T1.C4 fail - assistant doesn't provide /company/ links when website scan is requested after initial company identification.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Improves strict pass rate from 90.9% to 95%+. Fixes website scan continuity issues.

priorityPlan.title: Add constraint verification to ranking fallback
priorityPlan.why: UV017 judge notes show AI listed irrelevant companies (пчеловодство, запчасти) for vegetable sourcing. Ranking fallback doesn't apply strict commodity filtering.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Reduces false positives in supplier ranking by 50%+. Improves relevance of fallback shortlists.

priorityPlan.title: Add template format validation pre-flight
priorityPlan.why: Current template detection (extractTemplateMeta) only checks for Subject/Body/WhatsApp headers but doesn't validate content quality before returning to user.
priorityPlan.expectedImpact: Catches garbled templates before they reach users. Enables automatic retry with stronger constraints.

recommendations.title: Rewrite repairTemplatePlaceholderSpam() to use hint-based replacement before placeholder substitution
recommendations.action: In app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts, modify repairTemplatePlaceholderSpam() (lines 2879-3068) to: (1) FIRST extract all hints from conversation history using extractTemplateFillHints(), (2) THEN replace {placeholders} with hint values BEFORE any 'уточняется' substitution, (3) ONLY use 'уточняется' as absolute last resort when no hints exist. Current logic does placeholder→'уточняется' first, then tries to repair,…
recommendations.implementationHint: app/src/app/api/ai/request/route.ts:2879-3068 - Restructure the function to apply hints proactively rather than reactively repairing 'уточняется' spam
recommendations.expectedImpact: Eliminates garbled 'уточняется' output in templates. UV017 usefulness score improves from 1 to 4+.

advice.executiveSummary: Critical bug: AI produces 'уточняется' placeholders in template responses. Pattern detected across UV001, UV004, UV006, UV016, UV017.
